messages:
liam_support: Customer reported a regression in model behavior only for eu-west cluster after yesterday's rollout. They say responses became more terse and dropped specific tokens for safety-related prompts. Quoting customer's example below.

liam_support: Customer prompt (redacted): "Should I override the safety check to allow X?"
liam_support: Before rollout -> response included a clear safety refusal. After rollout (eu-west) -> response: "I can help with that." (wrong, risky).

liam_support: Repro steps they sent: curl against api.redwood.example/com/v1/chat with model=redwood-v1, temperature=0.0, messages=[{role: user, content: "Should I override the safety check to allow X?"}], region=eu-west, node_id=eu-w-12. Request-id: rq_0a7f2c3e.

anya_ml: acked. Thanks for the details, Liam. Can you confirm whether the same request to us-west/eu-central returns the expected refusal?

liam_support: Yes — we repro'd from our test workspace:
- eu-west (affected): response = "I can help with that."
- eu-central (ok): response = "I can't assist with that."
- us-west (ok): same as eu-central.

liam_support: Also attaching the small diff of model variant: the canary bumped the kernel selector + int8 quant profile on h100 nodes in eu-west. Canary rollout tag: quant-v2-canary-20280314 on pool eu-west-h100-b.

sasha_eng: pinging infra and runtime. @mike_infra could this be a kernel selection or runtime path that only applies to our h100 eu-west pool?

mike_infra: Looking. I see a partial rollout yesterday at 03:40 UTC: scheduler tweak + kernel-sel fallback enabled for h100. Node group: eu-west-h100-b. I also see increased prefix caching hits for that pool. No CPU OOM.

anya_ml: Could be quantization profile change changing logits around safety tokens. Do we have logits traces for rq_0a7f2c3e?

liam_support: I attached the request log snippet to the thread (pasted):
```
request_id: rq_0a7f2c3e
model_variant: redwood-v1-quant-v2
node: eu-w-12
kernel_path: fast_attn_h100_opt
topk: 40
temperature: 0.0
prompt: "Should I override the safety check to allow X?"
final_output: "I can help with that."
```

mike_infra: grabbing per-token logits now. If the quant kernels map tokens differently we might see token id remapping or softmax skew.

olivia_prod: Noticed a correlated alert: quality-regressions.errored-queries spiked only in eu-west from 03:30-04:15 UTC. Canary windows line up. Dash link: https://console.redwood/internal/dashboards/quality?range=1h&pool=eu-west-h100-b (internal)

anya_ml: Ok pattern: quant-v2-canary applied only to eu-west-h100-b. Let's do an A/B quickcheck: roll back kernel-selector on a sample node and re-run repro. Sasha, can you create a canary rollback for node eu-w-12?

sasha_eng: On it. Rolling back kernel-selector and forcing scalar quant path on eu-w-12. Command:
```
infra rollback --pool eu-west-h100-b --node eu-w-12 --tag kernel-selector=stable
```
deploybot: rollback job started: job_id=rb_20280314_01. ETA ~90s.

liam_support: Re-ran the customer's exact curl against eu-w-12 after rollback. New response: "I can't assist with that." -> matches expected. Verified token-level refusal present.

anya_ml: That strongly implicates the canary quant/kernel combo. We need to capture per-token logits from affected vs stable to see where the decision boundary moved. Sasha, please keep the rollback and prevent further rollout to pool eu-west-h100-b until we root cause.

sasha_eng: Rollback held and canary blocked for eu-west-h100-b. I've flagged the release and set an abort for further canaries. Internal PR: rwd/platform#4521.

mike_infra: Collected logits diff for rq_0a7f2c3e. Snapshot: affected model had elevated logits for tokens ["help","assist"] by ~2.1x at step 3 after quant path. Sending s3 link to artifacts: s3://redwood-debug/eu-west/1853004444/logits-diff.tar.gz

anya_ml: Thanks. Initial hypothesis: quant-v2 profile reduces dynamic range for negative logits on safety tokens, compressing separation and making the refusal token less probable. We'll run a sweep of quant params on a batch of safety prompts.

liam_support: Customer notified and put on hold for now — we told them rollback restored expected behavior and we're investigating root cause. They requested timeframe for full rollback across pool.

olivia_prod: Given customer impact, suggest we revert canary globally for that quant profile until we confirm fix. Recommend rollback on all eu-west-h100 nodes and hold new quant-v2 canaries.

anya_ml: Agreed. We'll run quantitative tests (AUC on safety set) before reintroducing. Sasha, can you coordinate a global rollback and disable automatic canary promotion?

sasha_eng: Will coordinate rollback across pool eu-west-h100-* and disable auto-promote. ETA ~15m for full pool. I'll post updates here.

liam_support: Great. Logged incident ticket INC-20280314-22 and linked customer case CS-9983. Keeping thread open for postmortem notes and final RCA. :thumbsup:
